Maya K.: Heads-up — Ana has a conflict for the candidate on 2026-03-18 10:00 PT. I can cover the first 15m but we need someone for the design/scale portion.
Samir Patel: I can cover the design/scale slot. Do you want me to replace Ana or join as an extra? I can do a full 45 if needed.
Maya K.: Prefer replace so we don't overload the panel. If you can take the middle chunk that would be perfect.
Samir Patel: ok, will do. Recruiting, can you run a swap? ` /swap @Ana -> @Samir Patel `
Recruiting Bot: calendar updated — Candidate: S. Lee | 2026-03-18 10:00 PT | Interviewers: Maya K., Samir Patel, Jordan R., Lina Chen. Room: VC-3 reserved. Invite and updated ICS sent to panel.
Lina Chen: quick rubric Q — for system design do we use the 'system_design' rubric (scale + tradeoffs) or the older 'design' entry?
Jordan R.: use `system_design` — it's the canonical one now. Scoring is 1-4. Here's the debrief template: https://intranet/recruiting/debrief-template (short checklist + example notes).
Maya K.: candidate consented to recording. Who gets access once infra uploads?
Samir Patel: infra auto-uploads to our interviews drive and grants view to panel emails and recruiting. If you need wider access, add the email now.
Lina Chen: scoring sanity check — 1 = strong no, 4 = strong yes, right?
Jordan R.: yep — 1 strong no, 2 weak no, 3 weak yes, 4 strong yes. Please add a 1-2 sentence justification for 1/2 or 3/4.
Maya K.: cool. I'll post a short prep note + candidate resume in this thread and ping 10m before. Reminder: fill debrief within 24h after interview :hourglass_flowing_sand:.
Samir Patel: :thumbsup:
Recruiting Bot: reminder scheduled — debrief nudges will ping the panel 1 hour and 24 hours after the interview end time.
